# [Baseline] - WIN - U - Attachment Scanning

Makes the virus scanner check every attachment at the moment the user opens it, not only when it is saved.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | User (U) — assign to user groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | All Users |
| Source | CIS v4 Windows 11 L1 — setting adopted from IntuneAdmin, value verified against the settings catalog definition. |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_U_Attachment_Scanning.json`](Baseline_WIN_U_Attachment_Scanning.json) |

> User-scoped, so assign to users and not to devices. Works with Defender and with any other scanner that registers as an antivirus provider. In addition, the zone information on a downloaded file is preserved (Mark of the Web). That mark is what Office Protected View and SmartScreen rely on; if it is lost, a downloaded document opens as if it came from the local disk and the most important brake disappears. The setting is named the other way round in the catalog — *Do not preserve zone information* set to Disabled means the information is in fact preserved.
